systems.system: Rede Nacional de Banda Larga (RNBL), National Broadband Infrastructure Upgrading Project
systems.owner: Government of Angola / Ministry of Finance (borrower); MINTTICS; Sinohydro (contractor)

note: A China Eximbank loan for a fibre network project (2,000 km terrestrial, Cabinda submarine line); it names no national broadband plan, its adoption, period or targets, so it is a single project and gives no fact.
